opportunities.title: Regular Grant (online portal)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations, and exempt or excepted organisations with at least one year of audited or independently examined accounts, operating within the UK or UKOTs, and not having received a grant or been declined within the past year.
opportunities.summary: The Garfield Weston Foundation provides regular grants for operating/core costs, projects, and capital works to eligible UK charities. Applications can be submitted at any time via the online Grants Portal.
